guide.text: Nurse Harley's signature gear. Grants bonus Crit Rate and stacking Crit Damage, perfectly complementing her rapid-fire enhanced basic attacks. Also boosts her Attack and, during her Ultimate, causes her basic attacks to deal extra physical damage based on the target's Max HP, ideal for shredding tanky enemies on the front row. A must-have for maintaining high burst and relentless pressure while in [Self-Actualization]
